response.overview: Two very different lads bump into each other by chance. Whilst Luka is mute and can only communicate with the help of a quirky hand puppet, Umut, who is Turkish, chatters away non-stop. He wants to be a policeman, a secret agent or a bodyguard. At first, Luka is just a crazy psycho to him, until he uncovers his secret. Together, they experience what is probably the most exciting day of their lives.
